summary: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Lansdowne Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services does not support the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Lansdowne Avenue and Whytock Avenue and is also not recommending a pedestrian crossover (PXO) near the TTC bus stops at No. 424 Lansdowne Avenue. The technical justifications for these installations are not satisfied. Therefore, the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Lansdowne Avenue and Whytock Avenue and a pedestrian crossover at No. 424 Lansdowne Avenue is not recommended.
decided: City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the installation of traffic control signals at the intersection of Lansdowne Avenue and Whytock Avenue. 2. City Council approve the installation of a pedestrian crossover at No. 424 Lansdowne Avenue (approximately 300 metres south of Bloor Street West).
